connections.choice.default.description: The first choice of connection: the workspace's default connection for the CLI, named ({name}).

connections.choice.defaultNone.description: The first choice of connection when the workspace has no connection on for the CLI: an agent on it is refused a start until one is.

connections.choice.gone.defaultMessage: A removed connection (the agent is refused a start)
connections.choice.gone.description: A choice of connection that no longer exists: the agent can't start until another is chosen.

connections.choice.label.description: Label of the choice of connection an agent runs on (Agent Settings, Add Agent, Settings → Assistant): which login or service runs it.

connections.choice.none.defaultMessage: No {cli} connection is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Connections.
connections.choice.none.description: Under the choice of connection when the workspace has none on for the CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code"). Settings → Connections names a section.

connections.choice.off.defaultMessage: {name} (off in this workspace: the default runs it)
connections.choice.off.description: A choice of connection that is chosen but off in this workspace ({name}): the workspace's default runs the agent instead.
